# Hudson Development LLC

> Home improvement contractor serving Teton Valley, Idaho (Driggs, Victor, Tetonia, Felt) and Jackson Hole, Wyoming. Owner-operated by Lucien Hudson Gutierrez, 25+ years in the trades. Licensed and insured. Free estimates. Open Monday through Saturday.

## Services
- Interior and exterior painting, residential and commercial
- Wood staining and finishing (siding, timber homes, decks, ceilings)
- Roofing and storm restoration for wind and hail damage
- Renovations and additions
- Carpentry and decks
- Pressure washing

## Background
Lucien grew up in a family of developers, general contractors, and builders and started in the trades at sixteen. He owned a painting and home improvement company for more than twelve years and spent over three years in roofing project management.
